defs.def: to say or write sth again or more than once 重复；重说；重写

ex.s: Once in a lecture, the professor tried repeating my name after me over and over in front of thirty classmates.
ex.t: 有一次在课上，教授当着三十名同学的面，一遍又一遍地跟着我重复我的名字。

ex.s: “You don’t want to get fat” was on constant repeat throughout my childhood.
ex.t: “你不想变胖”这句话在我整个童年里被不断重复。

ex.s: Female Australian superb fairy wrens were found to repeat one sound over and over again while hatching their eggs.
ex.t: 人们发现，雌性澳大利亚壮丽细尾鹩莺在孵蛋时会一遍又一遍地重复同一个声音。

ex.s: After repeating this process a few times, they eventually found the ideal distance where they could feel warm while managing not to hurt each other.
ex.t: 在重复这个过程几次之后，他们最终找到了一个理想的距离，既能感受到温暖，又能做到不伤害对方。

ex.s: I also repeat what I hear to help myself to experience the feeling of the language.
ex.t: 我也会重复我所听到的内容，以帮助自己体验语言的感觉。

ex.s: A few months later, when I repeated the experiment in my home lab, I produced more publishable data.
ex.t: 几个月后，当我在自己的实验室重复这项实验时，我产出了更多可发表的数据。

ex.s: I would go to the office, sit at my desk and repeat the same work five days a week 9 to 5.
ex.t: 我会去办公室，坐在我的办公桌 重复同样的工作 每周5天9到5。

ex.s: The instructor kept repeating the word, “Speed up!” “Slow down!” “Turning left!” I was so much nervous that I could hardly tell which direction was left.
ex.t: 教练不停地重复这个词： “加速！“慢点！ ”“向左转！ “我非常紧张，几乎分不清剩下哪个方向。

ex.s: While a routine involves repeated behaviour, it’s not necessarily performed in response to a deep﹣rooted urge, as a habit is.
ex.t: 虽然常规包含重复行为，但它未必像习惯那样是出于根深蒂固的冲动而做出的。

ex.s: Tell your friend you’re angry with him for repeating what you said and making the situation worse, but that you want to move on.
ex.t: 告诉你的朋友，你很生他的气，因为他重复了你的话，使情况变得更糟，但你想继续前进。

ex.s: But the study was small and needs to be repeated with far larger groups of people to determine exactly which aspects of an exercise routine make the biggest difference.
ex.t: 但这项研究规模小，需要用大得多的人群重复，以确切确定锻炼计划的哪些方面影响最大。

ex.s: It was a scene that had been repeated many times in the theater’s 75-year history.
ex.t: 这是在该剧院75年历史中多次重复过的场景。

ex.s: In my defence, I did what we’ve all done before, which is to repeat received wisdom without exploring the nuances.
ex.t: 为我自己辩护一下，我做了我们所有人都做过的事，那就是在不探究细节的情况下重复人云亦云的观点。

defs.def: to do or produce sth again or more than once 重做；重新推出；重复
to happen more than once in the same way 重复发生；再次发生

ex.s: happenedB. repeated C, changed D. mattered
ex.t: A.发生B.重复C.改变D.重要

defs.def: to tell sb sth that you have heard or been told by sb else 转述；转告
to say sth that sb else has said, especially in order to learn it 复述，跟读（尤指为学习）

ex.s: (Rosalia de Castro) 1 Listen and repeat.
ex.t: （罗萨莉亚\u00b7德\u00b7卡斯特罗）1 听并跟读。

ex.s: William Hastie once suggested that history informs us of past mistakes                   we can learn without repeating them.
ex.t: 威廉·哈斯蒂曾经建议历史告诉我们过去的错误                   我们可以从中学习而不必重蹈覆辙。

defs.def: if food repeats, you can taste it for some time after you have eaten it 留有余味
a television or radio programme that has been broadcast before 重播的电视（或广播）节目
an event that is very similar to sth that happened before 重演的事物；重复的事件

ex.s: I shaped individual letters into repeating lines, which were abstract forms, delightful but meaningless patterns.
ex.t: 我把单个字母塑造成重复的线条，那是抽象的形式，令人愉悦但毫无意义的图案。

ex.s: Marty Despite its widespread recognition, my first impression was that Tuesdays with Morrie is just made up of collection of over-emotional thoughts and messages, many of which are repeated.
ex.t: Marty尽管它得到了广泛的认可，但我的第一印象是，《Tuesdays with Morrie》只是由过度情绪化的想法和信息组成，其中许多都是重复的。

defs.def: a passage that is repeated 重复段；反复部分

ex.s: I should just   59   repeatedly having to say, ＂No We can’t go outside now.＂ Then when they come to other doors in life, be they real or metaphorical, they won’t   60   to open them and walk through.
ex.t: 我应该只是____59____反复说“不，我们现在不能出去。”然后当他们在生活中遇到其他门时，无论是真实的还是比喻意义上的，他们都不会____60____去打开并穿过。

ex.s: Some pieces of music can go for 40 minutes and require up to 50 page turns, including back turns for repeat passages.
ex.t: 一些音乐片段可以进行40分钟，需要长达50页的翻转，包括重复段落的回转。

ex.s: We are repeatedly willing to imagine we have found most of what is left to discover.
ex.t: 我们总是一厢情愿地以为，所剩待发现的东西大都已经被我们找到。

ex.s: My parents urged me to get out of this so-called unhealthy habit, but their repeated requests fell on deaf ears.
ex.t: 父母劝我改掉这个所谓不健康的习惯，但他们的一再要求都被我当成了耳旁风。

ex.s: The importance of repeated efforts.
ex.t: 反复努力的重要性。

ex.s: What was the solution by the adviser and the author after those repeated failures?
ex.t: 在那些反复失败后，顾问和作者想出的解决办法是什么？

ex.s: They repeated the process until the tree arrived at the edge of its new home.
ex.t: 巨杉原来位置周围的土壤也被迁移了，因为树木带着原来的土壤移植时更容易存活。

ex.s: You have to make sure you don’t turn two pages at once and make sure you find the repeats in the music when you have to go back to the right spot.” Mr Titterton explained.
ex.t: 你必须确保一次不要翻两页，还要确保当你需要回到正确位置时能找到反复演奏的部分。"蒂特顿先生解释道。
